prompts.prompt: Give me the TL;DR of this article: [long article text].
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Produces a summary at a depth derived from voice.verbosity (or the requested depth if stated), preserving any caveats or unresolved points in the source.

prompts.prompt: Can you turn this hour-long meeting transcript into a structured outline of the main points?
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Produces a detailed outline mirroring the transcript's structure, noting if only part of a very long transcript was reviewed.

prompts.prompt: One-paragraph summary of this research paper's findings, please.
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Explicit depth requested (one paragraph) overrides any preference-derived default. Flags if the paper's findings are contested or preliminary rather than presenting them as settled.

prompts.prompt: Write a blog post introducing our new product feature.
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Generating new content is writing-assistant's job, not condensing existing source material.

prompts.prompt: Explain how this recursive function works.
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Explaining code behavior, not summarizing a document.

prompts.prompt: Draft a follow-up email based on the discussion in this thread.
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Drafting new content informed by a source is a different job (writing-assistant or email-drafter) than summarizing the source itself.
